blocks.title: Maintenance
blocks.text: Maintenance is the final phase of the SDLC: ongoing maintenance and updates make sure the software continues to function correctly and adapts to changes in user needs or technology.
Maintenance is like taking care of a plant: you need to water it regularly and deal with any problems to keep it healthy and growing.

blocks.prompt: Why does software still need work after it has been deployed?
blocks.explanation: Users' needs and technology keep changing and new problems appear, so the software needs updates and fixes to keep working correctly; this is the maintenance phase.

items: Maintenance: final SDLC phase; ongoing updates and fixes so the software keeps working and adapts to change; like caring for a plant.
